stack_spec.name: Spec4.ai website
stack_spec.description: The public reference-documentation website for Spec4 — a hand-written, static, no-JavaScript multi-page site served from GitHub Pages, unified this round by a single shared stylesheet.

languages.name: HTML
languages.role: markup for the thirteen styled pages (front page, eleven docs pages, bws4) and the meta-refresh redirect stubs (about/, how-it-works/, agents/*/)

naming_conventions.files_and_folders: lowercase, hyphenated (kebab-case), matching existing repo structure

languages.name: CSS
languages.version: CSS3, including the prefers-color-scheme media feature
languages.role: the single shared stylesheet (styles.css) driving typography, nav, tables, code blocks, figures, and the light/dark scheme across all thirteen styled pages
languages.quotes: double quotes for any quoted values (e.g. font-family names, url())
languages.css_custom_properties: every color and font declared as a custom property on :root
languages.file_organization: single stylesheet, ordered: design tokens (:root custom properties) → base elements → nav → components (table wrapper, code panel, figure) → page-specific overrides

targets.name: website
targets.purpose: the public Spec4 reference site — thirteen hand-written HTML pages, redirect stubs, one shared stylesheet, self-hosted fonts, images, and SEO/sharing metadata
targets.hosting: GitHub Pages, served under the existing custom domain via the repository's CNAME file
targets.build: none — files are served exactly as authored, no build step, no bundler
targets.distribution: published on push to the repository's configured GitHub Pages branch/directory

exposure.transport: HTTPS only — GitHub Pages 'Enforce HTTPS' enabled for the custom domain

site_source.choice: Hand-written HTML files (thirteen styled pages plus meta-refresh redirect stubs) and one shared CSS file, committed to the repository and served as-is with no build step
site_source.durability: source of truth; survives via git history. Content is hand-authored in two places kept manually in sync — the rework/ copy files (the authoritative text source) and the corresponding HTML (the served mirror) — with no automated build tying them together
site_source.purpose: the entire site's content and presentation, published directly by GitHub Pages on push

collections.name: pages
physical: one index.html per route path — front page, 11 docs pages, bws4 (13 total); plus separate meta-refresh redirect stubs for about/, how-it-works/, agents/*/ that do not carry the stylesheet

collections.name: stylesheet
physical: single styles.css file, referenced by every one of the thirteen styled pages

collections.name: copy_source
physical: one Markdown copy file per styled page, plus register.md, under rework/
collections.purpose: the authoritative text source each page's HTML is hand-mirrored against; not served, not templated

collections.name: examples
physical: static generated example artifacts under examples/ (deployment-plan.html, mock.html), self-contained with their own inline styles
collections.purpose: Spec4's own generated example output, displayed as reference material; unaffected by the unified stylesheet

bundled_assets.choice: Self-hosted JetBrains Mono webfont files (two weights, .woff2) plus existing images, committed to the repo and served statically; the reading typeface is a system font stack declared in CSS, with no font files shipped for it
bundled_assets.purpose: typography and imagery assets referenced by the stylesheet and pages without any third-party runtime request

collections.name: fonts
collections.purpose: two weights of JetBrains Mono, .woff2 only, for monospace/code/nav/version text; the reading face is a system font stack with no files

project_structure.purpose: front page — one of the thirteen styled pages

project_structure.path: docs/ (index + rounds, artifacts, settings, codescanner, brainstormer, agentifier, designer, stackadvisor, phaser, deployer)
project_structure.purpose: product documentation pages — eleven of the thirteen styled pages
rebuilt page, one of the thirteen styled pages
meta-refresh redirect stubs to corresponding /docs/ pages, kept only so old inbound links still land; no stylesheet reference; untouched this round
Spec4's own generated output artifacts, self-contained with their own inline styles; not styled or touched this round
the copy files, one per page, and register.md — the source every page's text is edited against; not served, not reorganised, not touched by this round
the single shared stylesheet — tokens, base elements, nav, components, page-specific overrides, in that order
two weights of JetBrains Mono, .woff2 only
crawl configuration, sitemap, and custom-domain mapping for GitHub Pages

patterns: identical page skeleton across all thirteen styled pages: head → nav → main, with no footer — the nav already carries the version, and every fact the mock's footer line held is already present on the front page's trust strip
documentation: every styled page has a corresponding copy file under rework/ that is its authoritative source; the page's rendered text matches that file word-for-word; a change is made in the copy file first, then mirrored into the HTML
styles.css uses section-header comments marking the ordering: tokens → base elements → nav → components (table wrapper, code panel, figure) → page-specific overrides

additional_decisions.name: html_validation_convention
additional_decisions.description: The manual pre-commit check applied to HTML markup
additional_decisions.value: Every page is checked against the W3C Nu Html Checker (https://validator.w3.org/nu/) before commit; no automated CI enforcement, no library dependency

references.standard: Google Fonts (source/license for the self-hosted JetBrains Mono files)
WHATWG HTML Living Standard (meta http-equiv=refresh, used by the redirect stubs)
